newsitem.title: SPAIN: TABLE - Spain's Sepi H1 net profit up 40.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Spain's Sepi H1 net profit up 40.4 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish state holding company SEPI for the first half of 1997 (in billions of pesetas, unless stated):
Businesses managed net profit 91.78 up 2 pct
Energy sector net profit 84.4 vs n.a.
Aerospace sector net profit 4.1 vs n.a.
Information tech net profit 0.45 vs n.a.
NOTE: Energy sector business comprises stakes in Endesa, Red Electrica and Enusa.
Privatisation income comprises sales of stakes in Repsol, Sodical and Almagrera.
SEPI's aerospace sector comprises stakes in Iberia and Aviaco.
The company said in a statement that its information technology businesses had benefitted from a steady increase in contracting and a reduction of financial costs.
Of the 11 sectors in which SEPI operates, all results were positive except for those of capital goods and paper pulp.
